lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well that that morning he said that if he wanted me ta come over like at six-thirty and he had the fire started cuz he wanted to bu, ah, to burn some tires

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: So he had it started and the jeep was still in there.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: So the Monte's not in there. (Brendan shakes head “no”)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Who's car was in the garage? Tell me the truth.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: We already know. Just tell us. It's OK.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: The truth, that's its so easy to tell the truth. It's hard ta make things up.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Her jeep was in the ga-garage wasn't it? (Brendan nods “yes”)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And you, you tell me if I'm wrong but when you were at the house, you just went over there cuz you had talked about it in the morning. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: There was no call from Steven asking you to come over was there? And you went over, was the big door closed? (Brendan shakes head “no”)
